questions.stem: What is the main purpose of using probability in everyday life?
choices: To measure the length of objects
To predict the exact outcome of random events
To determine the exact time of an event
To express the likelihood of events
questions.solution: Probability is used to express how likely an event is to happen, based on available information. It does not measure physical properties like length, nor can it predict exact outcomes of random events, which are inherently uncertain. It also does not determine the exact time of an event, as time is not directly related to probability. The correct answer is 'To express the likelihood of events.'

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of an event with an 'even chance'?
choices: A die showing a 6
A coin landing on its edge
A card drawn from a deck being a heart
A coin landing on heads
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'A coin landing on heads' because it has an equal chance of happening as landing on tails. 'A die showing a 6' is less likely, 'A card drawn from a deck being a heart' is more likely, and 'A coin landing on its edge' is not a typical outcome in probability problems.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of a 'certain' event?
choices: Drawing a red card from a deck of 52 cards
Rolling a 7 on a six-sided die
A student passing an exam
All the sweets in a bag being red
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'All the sweets in a bag being red' because it is guaranteed to happen if all the sweets are red. 'Drawing a red card from a deck of 52 cards' is not certain, 'Rolling a 7 on a six-sided die' is impossible, and 'A student passing an exam' is not certain.

questions.stem: If the probability of an event is 0, what does it mean?
choices: The event is certain to happen
The event is impossible to happen
The event has an equal chance of happening or not happening
The event is more likely to happen than not
questions.solution: A probability of 0 means the event cannot occur under any circumstances. This is because probability values range from 0 to 1, with 0 representing absolute impossibility. The other options describe probabilities of 1, 0.5, and values greater than 0.5, which correspond to certainty, equal chances, and higher likelihood, respectively.

घटना होने या न होने की समान संभावना है

hi.solution: 0 की संभावना का अर्थ है कि घटना किसी भी परिस्थिति में घट नहीं सकती। यह इसलिए है क्योंकि संभावना के मान 0 से 1 के बीच होते हैं, जहां 0 पूर्ण असंभवता का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है। अन्य विकल्प 1, 0.5 और 0.5 से अधिक मानों के अनुरूप हैं, जो क्रमशः निश्चितता, समान संभावना और अधिक संभावितता के अर्थ में आते हैं।

questions.stem: A fair die is rolled. What is the probability of getting a number greater than 4?
questions.solution: The possible outcomes when a die is rolled are 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6. Numbers greater than 4 are 5 and 6, which are 2 outcomes. So, the probability is 2/6, which simplifies to 1/3. The option '1/6' is incorrect because it only considers one outcome. The option '1/2' is incorrect because it assumes 3 outcomes. The option '2/3' is incorrect because it assumes 4 outcomes.

hi.stem: एक न्याय्य पासा फेंका जाता है। 4 से बड़ी संख्या प्राप्त करने की प्रायिकता क्या है?
hi.solution: जब एक पासा फेंका जाता है तो संभावित परिणाम 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 और 6 होते हैं। 4 से बड़ी संख्याएँ 5 और 6 हैं, जो 2 परिणाम हैं। इसलिए, प्रायिकता 2/6 है, जो सरलीकृत होकर 1/3 हो जाती है। विकल्प '1/6' गलत है क्योंकि यह केवल एक परिणाम को मानता है। विकल्प '1/2' गलत है क्योंकि यह 3 परिणामों को मानता है। विकल्प '2/3' गलत है क्योंकि यह 4 परिणामों को मानता है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate mathematical terminology.

mr.stem: एका न्याय्य छक्का फेकल्यास 4 पेक्षा मोठ्या संख्येच्या मिळण्याची शक्यता किती?
mr.solution: छक्का फेकल्यास शक्य परिणाम 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 आणि 6 असतात. 4 पेक्षा मोठ्या संख्या 5 आणि 6 असून त्यांचे परिणाम 2 असतात. म्हणून, शक्यता 2/6 असून ती 1/3 वर घटविता येते. पर्याय '1/6' अयोग्य आहे कारण तो केवळ एक परिणाम विचारात घेतो. पर्याय '1/2' अयोग्य आहे कारण तो 3 परिणाम विचारात घेतो. पर्याय '2/3' अयोग्य आहे कारण तो 4 परिणाम विचारात घेतो.
mr.critique: The Marathi translation accurately reflects the English question and solution, with appropriate terminology used in a Marathi educational context.

questions.stem: A fair 6-sided die is rolled. What is the probability of rolling an even number?
questions.solution: The sample space for rolling a die is {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}. The even numbers are 2, 4, and 6, so there are 3 favorable outcomes. The probability is 3/6 = 1/2. The option '1/6' is incorrect because it assumes only one favorable outcome. '1/3' is incorrect because it assumes only two favorable outcomes. '2/3' is incorrect because it suggests more than half of the outcomes are even.

hi.stem: एक न्यायसंगत 6-भुज घनाकृति के फेंके जाने पर, सम संख्या आने की प्रायिकता क्या है?
hi.solution: घनाकृति फेंके जाने के नमूना स्थान {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6} है। सम संख्याएँ 2, 4 और 6 हैं, इसलिए 3 अनुकूल परिणाम हैं। प्रायिकता 3/6 = 1/2 है। विकल्प '1/6' गलत है क्योंकि यह केवल एक अनुकूल परिणाम के असमान अनुमान के लिए है। '1/3' गलत है क्योंकि यह केवल दो अनुकूल परिणाम के असमान अनुमान के लिए है। '2/3' गलत है क्योंकि यह यह सुझाव देता है कि अधिकांश परिणाम सम हैं।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate mathematical terminology.

mr.stem: एक न्याय्य 6-बाजूचा छक्का फेकला जातो. सम नंबर फेकण्याची शक्यता किती?
mr.solution: छक्का फेकल्याचा नमुना अंक आहे {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}. सम अंक 2, 4 आणि 6 आहेत, म्हणून 3 अनुकूल निकाल आहेत. शक्यता 3/6 = 1/2 आहे. '1/6' चूक आहे कारण ते फक्त एक अनुकूल निकाल मानते. '1/3' चूक आहे कारण ते फक्त दोन अनुकूल निकाल मानते. '2/3' चूक आहे कारण ते सांगते की अधिकतर निकाल सम आहेत.
mr.critique: The Marathi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate terminology.

questions.stem: A bag contains 4 red balls and 5 blue balls. One ball is drawn and laid aside, and a second ball is drawn. What is the probability of drawing a red ball and then a blue ball?
questions.solution: The probability of drawing a red ball first is 4/9. After one red ball is laid aside, there are 8 balls left (3 red and 5 blue). The probability of drawing a blue ball next is 5/8. Multiplying these probabilities gives (4/9) × (5/8) = 20/72 = 5/18, which simplifies to 20/81. The option '4/9' is incorrect because it only considers the first draw. The option '5/9' is incorrect because it assumes the second draw has 9 balls. The option '40/81' is incorrect because it assumes both draws have 9 balls.

hi.solution: पहले एक लाल गेंद निकालने की प्रायिकता 4/9 है। एक लाल गेंद एक ओर रख देने के बाद, 8 गेंदें बच जाती हैं (3 लाल और 5 नीली)। अगले चरण में एक नीली गेंद निकालने की प्रायिकता 5/8 है। इन प्रायिकताओं को गुणा करने पर (4/9) × (5/8) = 20/72 = 5/18, जो 20/81 में सरलीकृत हो जाता है। विकल्प '4/9' गलत है क्योंकि यह केवल पहले निकाले गए गेंद को ध्यान में रखता है। विकल्प '5/9' गलत है क्योंकि यह दूसरे निकाले गए गेंद के लिए 9 गेंदों की परिकल्पना करता है। विकल्प '40/81' गलत है क्योंकि यह दोनों निकाले गए गेंद के लिए 9 गेंदों की परिकल्पना करता है।

questions.stem: If a fair coin is tossed 100 times, and it lands on heads 52 times, what can be concluded about the fairness of the coin?

questions.solution: The correct answer is 'The coin is fair because the result is close to 50%' because the result (52 heads out of 100) is close to the expected 50%, which is normal in random outcomes. 'The coin is biased towards heads' and 'The coin is biased because it landed on heads more than tails' are incorrect because a small deviation does not indicate bias. 'The coin is fair because the number of heads is more than tails' is also incorrect because more heads does not prove fairness.

questions.solution: The probability of an event not happening is 1 minus the probability of it happening. If the probability of the event happening is 0.3, then the probability of it not happening is 1 - 0.3 = 0.7. The option 0.3 is incorrect because it is the probability of the event happening, not not happening. The option 0.5 is incorrect because it assumes the probabilities are equal. questions.stem: In a sample space, the probability of event A is 0.4 and the probability of event B is 0.3. If A and B are mutually exclusive events, what is the probability of either A or B occurring?
questions.solution: For mutually exclusive events, the probability of either A or B occurring is the sum of their probabilities. This is 0.4 + 0.3 = 0.7.
